title: Owl & Co. report: the podcast industry generated $9.2B in sales globally in 2025, up 23% YoY, with 73% of the growth in the US coming from video-related revenue (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Owl & Co. report: the podcast industry generated $9.2B in sales globally in 2025, up 23% YoY, with 73% of the growth in the US coming from video-related revenue — According to a new report, 73% of the podcast industry's growth last year in the US came from video-related revenue
